001package io.jstach.rainbowgum;
002
003import java.net.URI;
004import java.net.URISyntaxException;
005import java.util.Collection;
006import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
007import java.util.Set;
008import java.util.TreeSet;
009
010import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
011
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.PropertyProblem;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.Result;
014
015/**
016 * Log LogProvider Source.
017 */
018public sealed interface LogProviderRef {
019
020        /**
021         * URI of the log provider.
022         * @return uri not <code>null</code>.
023         */
024        URI uri();
025
026        /**
027         * Property key from where the URI came from or <code>null</code>.
028         * @return property key.
029         */
030        @Nullable String keyOrNull();
031
032        /**
033         * Creates a log provider ref from URI.
034         * @param uri uri.
035         * @return ref.
036         */
037        public static LogProviderRef of(URI uri) {
038                return new DefaultLogProviderRef(uri, null);
039        }
040
041        /**
042         * Create a provider ref from a property result.
043         * @param property successful URI result.
044         * @return provider ref.
045         */
046        public static LogProviderRef of(Result.Success<? extends URI> property) {
047                return new DefaultLogProviderRef(property.value(), property.key());
048        }
049
050        /**
051         * Creates a log provider ref from URI.
052         * @param uri uri.
053         * @param key property key where URI came from.
054         * @return ref.
055         */
056        public static LogProviderRef of(URI uri, @Nullable String key) {
057                return new DefaultLogProviderRef(uri, key);
058        }
059
060        /**
061         * Thrown if a provider could not be found for the ref.
062         */
063        public static final class NotFoundException extends NoSuchElementException implements PropertyProblem {
064
065                private static final long serialVersionUID = 5484668688480940159L;
066
067                NotFoundException(String s) {
068                        super(s);
069                }
070
071                @Override
072                public String errorName() {
073                        return "NotFoundException";
074                }
075
076                /**
077                 * Builds a {@link NotFoundException} for an unregistered scheme, with a message
078                 * consistent across every kind of provider registry (output/publisher/encoder/
079                 * etc). If the scheme happens to be one known to be provided by an optional
080                 * module not currently on the classpath (see {@link ProviderModule}), the message
081                 * is extended to say which dependency to add. Otherwise it suggests a similarly
082                 * spelled scheme and lists the registered ones.
083                 * @param component the kind of thing not found.
084                 * @param scheme the URI scheme that had no provider registered for it.
085                 * @param uri the full URI that was being resolved.
086                 * @param registered the schemes registered for the component.
087                 * @return exception, not thrown.
088                 */
089                static NotFoundException of(ProviderModule.ComponentType component, String scheme, URI uri,
090                                Collection<? extends String> registered) {
091                        String message = "No " + component.label() + " found. Scheme not registered. scheme: '" + scheme
092                                        + "', URI: '" + LogRedactor.redactUri(uri) + "'";
093                        var module = ProviderModule.find(component, scheme);
094                        if (module.isPresent()) {
095                                return new NotFoundException(message + moduleHint(module.get()));
096                        }
097                        var candidates = new TreeSet<String>(registered);
098                        for (var m : ProviderModule.values()) {
099                                if (m.componentType() == component) {
100                                        candidates.add(m.scheme());
101                                }
102                        }
103                        String suggested = similarlySpelledScheme(scheme, candidates);
104                        if (suggested != null) {
105                                message += ". Did you mean '" + suggested + "'?";
106                        }
107                        // core. prefixed aliases only repeat the plain schemes.
108                        var listed = new TreeSet<String>(registered);
109                        listed.removeIf(r -> r.startsWith("core."));
110                        if (!listed.isEmpty()) {
111                                message += (suggested == null ? ". " : " ") + "Registered " + component.label() + " schemes: "
112                                                + String.join(", ", listed.stream().map(r -> "'" + r + "'").toList());
113                        }
114                        if (suggested != null && !registered.contains(suggested)) {
115                                var suggestedModule = ProviderModule.find(component, suggested);
116                                if (suggestedModule.isPresent()) {
117                                        message += moduleHint(suggestedModule.get());
118                                }
119                        }
120                        return new NotFoundException(message);
121                }
122
123                private static String moduleHint(ProviderModule m) {
124                        return ". Scheme '" + m.scheme() + "' is provided by module '" + m.moduleName() + "' (Maven: '"
125                                        + m.mavenGav() + "'). Add that dependency. See " + m.docUrl();
126                }
127
128                /*
129                 * The same spelling distance as unused key suggestions, but scaled to the
130                 * scheme's length so a short unknown scheme is not matched to an unrelated short
131                 * one.
132                 */
133                private static @Nullable String similarlySpelledScheme(String scheme, Set<String> candidates) {
134                        String normalized = UnusedKeyCheck.normalize(scheme);
135                        String best = null;
136                        int bestDistance = UnusedKeyCheck.MAX_DISTANCE + 1;
137                        for (String candidate : candidates) {
138                                if (UnusedKeyCheck.normalize(candidate).equals(normalized)) {
139                                        return candidate;
140                                }
141                                int limit = Math.min(UnusedKeyCheck.MAX_DISTANCE, Math.max(1, candidate.length() / 3));
142                                int distance = UnusedKeyCheck.distance(scheme, candidate, bestDistance);
143                                if (distance <= limit && distance < bestDistance) {
144                                        best = candidate;
145                                        bestDistance = distance;
146                                }
147                        }
148                        return best;
149                }
150
151        }
152
153}
154
155record DefaultLogProviderRef(URI uri, @Nullable String keyOrNull) implements LogProviderRef {
156        static URI normalize(URI uri) {
157                String scheme = uri.getScheme();
158                String path = uri.getPath();
159                try {
160                        if (scheme == null) {
161                                if (path == null) {
162                                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("URI is not proper: " + LogRedactor.redactUri(uri));
163                                }
164                                uri = new URI(path + ":///");
165                                if (uri.getScheme() == null) {
166                                        /*
167                                         * A leading "/" or "." keeps the URI parser from ever attempting
168                                         * scheme detection, so appending ":///" above silently produces
169                                         * another scheme-less URI instead of throwing. Fail clearly here
170                                         * rather than letting an unresolvable URI reach a provider registry.
171                                         */
172                                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("URI is not proper: " + LogRedactor.redactUri(uri));
173                                }
174                        }
175                }
176                catch (URISyntaxException e) {
177                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("URI is not proper: " + LogRedactor.redactUri(uri));
178                }
179                return uri;
180        }
181
182        static LogProviderRef normalize(LogProviderRef ref) {
183                var uri = ref.uri();
184                uri = DefaultLogProviderRef.normalize(uri);
185                return new DefaultLogProviderRef(uri, ref.keyOrNull());
186        }
187}
